functions.name: AddEditModeEvents
documentation: Adds a predefined set of events to the timeline for display in Edit Mode.

functions.name: AddScriptEvent
documentation: Adds a custom event to the timeline.

functions.name: CancelAllScriptEvents
documentation: Cancels all custom timeline events, removing them from the timeline.

functions.name: CancelEditModeEvents
documentation: Removes all Edit Mode events from the timeline.

functions.name: CancelScriptEvent
documentation: Cancels a custom timeline event, removing it from the timeline.

functions.name: FinishScriptEvent
documentation: Finishes a custom timeline event, removing it from the timeline.

functions.name: GetCurrentTime
documentation: Returns the current timestamp used for rendering the timeline display.

functions.name: GetEventColor
documentation: Returns the current color used to render timeline event.

functions.name: GetEventCountBySource
documentation: Returns the number of present events in the timeline by their source type.

functions.name: GetEventHighlightTime
documentation: Returns the duration at which timeline events will be highlighted for imminency.

functions.name: GetEventInfo
documentation: Returns information about a timeline event. This data is generally expected to be static for the lifetime of an event.

functions.name: GetEventList
documentation: Returns an unsorted list of event IDs present in the timeline.

functions.name: GetEventState
documentation: Returns the current state of a timeline event.

functions.name: GetEventTimeElapsed
documentation: Returns the elapsed duration of a timeline event.

functions.name: GetEventTimeRemaining
documentation: Returns the remaining duration of a timeline event.

functions.name: GetEventTimer
documentation: Returns a Duration object that tracks the elapsed duration of a timeline event. This object tracks the range [0, duration] of the event and automatically pauses its progression based on event state.

functions.name: GetEventTrack
documentation: Returns information about the position of an event on the timeline.

functions.name: GetSortedEventList
documentation: Returns a sorted list of event IDs present in the timeline from shortest to longest remaining durations, meeting the requirements of the specified filters.

arguments.name: maxEventCount
documentation: Maximum number of sorted events to return.

arguments.name: maxEventDuration
documentation: Maximum duration of sorted events to return.

arguments.name: excludeTerminalStates
documentation: If false, include events that are terminal states such as Canceled or Finished.

arguments.name: excludeHiddenEvents
documentation: If false, include events that should be hidden by user configuration, such as events on long tracks when the user has opted to not show long countdowns.

functions.name: GetTrackInfo
documentation: Returns information for a single timeline track.

functions.name: GetTrackList
documentation: Returns information about all timeline tracks.

functions.name: GetTrackMaxEventDuration
documentation: Returns the maximum permitted event duration on a single timeline track.

functions.name: GetTrackType
documentation: Returns the type of a single timeline track.

functions.name: GetViewType
documentation: Returns the current view type of the timeline.

functions.name: HasActiveEvents
documentation: Returns true if the timeline contains any events in the active state.

functions.name: HasAnyEvents
documentation: Returns true if the timeline contains any events in any state.

functions.name: HasPausedEvents
documentation: Returns true if the timeline contains any events in the paused state.

functions.name: HasVisibleEvents
documentation: Returns true if the timeline contains any events that are on visible tracks.

functions.name: IsEventBlocked
documentation: Returns true if the event is in a 'blocked' state, where the cast for this event may not occur due to encounter conditions not being met.

functions.name: IsFeatureAvailable
documentation: Returns true if the encounter timeline feature is available on this client.

functions.name: IsFeatureEnabled
documentation: Returns true if the encounter timeline feature has been enabled by the player. This function will always return false if the feature is not available.

functions.name: PauseScriptEvent
documentation: Pauses a custom timeline event, hiding it from the timeline. A paused event can later be resumed to show it again, or canceled.

functions.name: ResumeScriptEvent
documentation: Resumes a custom timeline event, showing it on the timeline again if it is currently paused.

functions.name: SetEventIconTextures
documentation: Updates a given vector of texture objects to reference art assets for icons associated with an event.

arguments.name: includeIcons
documentation: Mask to apply to candidate icons. Any icon bits not present in this set will not be assigned to textures.

arguments.name: textures
documentation: Array of texture objects to update. This will change the assigned atlases and alpha values of the region, applying secret aspects to protect the data.

functions.name: SetViewType
documentation: Changes the view type for the timeline. This adjusts track layouts to be more appropriate for a specific mode and optimizes event processing.

events.name: EncounterTimelineEventAdded
documentation: Fired when an event has been added to the timeline.

events.name: EncounterTimelineEventBlockStateChanged
documentation: Fired when an event has transitioned into or out of a 'blocked' status.

events.name: EncounterTimelineEventColorChanged
documentation: Fired when an event has met a condition that should trigger a color change.

events.name: EncounterTimelineEventHighlight
documentation: Fired when an event has met a condition that should trigger its highlight glow animation.

events.name: EncounterTimelineEventRemoved
documentation: Fired when an event has been removed from the timeline. This is guaranteed to fire after an event has transitioned to a 'final' state such as Canceled or Finished, and will be delayed at least one game tick to allow for API queries to still access event data in OnUpdate scripts. This is fired post-removal of the event, and so queries using the supplied event ID will return nil.

events.name: EncounterTimelineEventStateChanged
documentation: Fired when an event has changed state.

events.name: EncounterTimelineEventTrackChanged
documentation: Fired when an event has changed track, or has been re-ordered within its existing track.

events.name: EncounterTimelineLayoutUpdated
documentation: Fired when the layout of tracks on the timeline has been updated. This can include changes to the minimum or maximum durations of tracks.

events.name: EncounterTimelineStateUpdated
documentation: Signaled when conditions controlling the visibility of the encounter timeline are updated.

events.name: EncounterTimelineViewActivated
documentation: Fired when a new timeline view is being activated. This is fired after a full layout and timeline data update, allowing the UI to immediately query the API and get usable results.

events.name: EncounterTimelineViewDeactivated
documentation: Fired when the current timeline view is being deactivated. The UI should clear all stored timeline event data and release all frames back to pools during this event.

fields.name: maxEventCount
documentation: Maximum number of sorted events to return.

fields.name: maxEventDuration
documentation: Maximum duration of sorted events to return.

fields.name: excludeTerminalStates
documentation: If false, include events that are terminal states such as Canceled or Finished.

fields.name: excludeHiddenEvents
documentation: If false, include events that should be hidden by user configuration, such as events on long tracks when the user has opted to not show long countdowns.

fields.name: id
documentation: Instance ID for this event.

fields.name: source
documentation: Source that this event came from.

fields.name: spellName
documentation: Spell name associated with this event. For script events, this may instead be the contents of the 'overrideName' field if it wasn't empty.

fields.name: spellID
documentation: Spell ID associated with this event.

fields.name: iconFileID
documentation: Icon file ID associated with this event.

fields.name: duration
documentation: Base duration of this event at the point that it was queued onto the timeline.

fields.name: maxQueueDuration
documentation: Hold duration for this event after it reaches the end of the timeline. During this period, the event will sit in the queued track of the timeline until manually finished or this added duration expires.

fields.name: icons
documentation: Bitmask of active icon states for this event.

fields.name: severity
documentation: Severity of this event.

fields.name: isApproximate
documentation: If true, this event is an approximation and may not occur exactly when the timeline suggests it will.

fields.name: minimumDuration
documentation: The exclusive lower bound of durations for events on this track. If zero, this should be treated as an inclusive lower bound. This bound is ignored by the timeline sequence in circumstances where an adjacent Sorted track would exceed its maximum event count, requiring events be pushed 'to the left' by one track.

fields.name: maximumDuration
documentation: The inclusive upper bound of durations for events on this track.

fields.name: minimumEventIntroDuration
documentation: Lower duration bound for events that want to transition onto this track from an Indeterminate position. Events below this duration are artificially kept in the indeterminate track state until they can transition into a later track in the timeline sequence.

fields.name: minimumEventGapDuration
documentation: Minimum duration gap that must exist between two sequential candidate events for this track. If two event durations have a distance under this figure, the later of the two events will be artifically kept in the indeterminate track state until it can transition into a later track in the timeline sequence.

fields.name: maximumEventCount
documentation: The maximum number of events permitted within this track. This only applies to Sorted tracks.

fields.name: sortDirection
documentation: Sort ordering for events within this track. This only applies to Sorted tracks.
